//startCommand: Deliberately absent. The Dockerfile's CMD is the entrypoint, and it is the only place that knows the image layout. A startCommand here previously read 'node .next/standalone/server.js' — the path used to run the server from a repo checkout, not the path inside the image, where COPY .next/standalone ./ puts server.js at /app/server.js. It silently overrode the correct CMD and every container exited with MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
//NOT-CONFIG-cron: READ THIS BEFORE ASSUMING THE JOBS RUN. Railway does NOT schedule anything from this file, and these '//' keys are inert comments, not settings — nothing below this line has any effect on a deployment. Both jobs must be created as REAL scheduled jobs (a Railway cron service, Supabase pg_cron + net.http_post, GitHub Actions, or cron-job.org) as described in LAUNCH.md Block 3. They fail closed and silently: without CRON_SECRET the endpoints answer 503, and an unscheduled job produces no error anywhere — only silence. Treat 'the schedules are in railway.json' as false.
//NOT-CONFIG-cron:expire-clicks: INTENDED schedule (create it yourself, see above): 0 3 * * * — GET /api/cron/expire-clicks with the CRON_SECRET bearer token. Deletes click events past the 90-day retention window (specifications/10-attribution.md §11). Retention that is documented but never executed is not retention.
